Recording active only after writer/session acceptance (snapshot verification before controller commit)
No sample admitted before start or after stop (typed verdicts, bounded ledger)
Stop/finalize/promotion/recovery idempotent (fault matrix K0-K6 + concurrent-stop regressions)
